title: Task
description: A unit of requested work and the authoritative record for its work metadata. Delivered inside an InboxItem envelope of kind 'task' (ADR 0010); the control plane copies sender/recipient, correlation_id, priority, and deadline into the envelope for routing/indexing and validates that the copies match. A delegated worker task is the same Task shape with parent_task_id and delegation populated (ADR 0012). State transitions: the recipient moves accepted/running/waiting/blocked/completed/failed; the sender (or a human) may cancel any non-terminal task, which the control plane records and notifies to the recipient.

parent_task_id.description: Set on delegated subtasks to the manager's current task id; enables parent/child correlation.

sender_id.description: Principal that requested/created this work; authoritative over the task delivery envelope copy.

recipient_id.description: Agent or ephemeral worker assigned this work; authoritative over the task delivery envelope copy.

delegation.description: Worker-specific execution policy. Present only for tasks delegated to an ephemeral worker (ADR 0012).

result_item_id.description: Id of the terminal InboxItem that delivered this task's outcome (ADR 0007).
